en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own kiosk plan and get the same own-brand versus franchise cash test
en.runTitle: Kuala Lumpur: a bubble tea kiosk for two sisters on RM 120,000 of savings

fields.label: Franchise offer
fields.value: A small franchise (no specific offer yet)

fields.label: KL or PJ site
fields.value: A mid-tier shopping mall in Kuala Lumpur or Petaling Jaya

fields.label: Savings, maximum borrowing and separate personal reserve
fields.value: RM 120,000 saved between us; borrow no more than RM 50,000

fields.label: All-in rent and opening quotes
fields.placeholder: e.g. a mall quote of RM 9,000 a month all-in and an RM 60,000 fit-out quote

fields.label: Paid sales test and realised ticket
fields.placeholder: e.g. a 2-week weekend stall: 80 paid cups a day at RM 11.50 each

fields.label: Owner hours and required drawings
fields.placeholder: e.g. both of us on the counter 40 hours a week, taking RM 2,000 each a month

fields.label: Halal needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. certification wanted from opening day, with a Muslim team member on every shift

en.template: Help us compare an own-brand tea kiosk and {franchise} in {site} using {money}, {costs}, {sales}, {owner} and {halal}. Show slow-start cash, break-even and missing costs. Ask before contacting anyone, submitting forms or sharing documents.

phases.title: Research Malaysian costs, rules, ingredient prices and franchise packages
phases.note: Registration, licences, wages, halal rules, supplier prices and delivery-platform fees
phases.judgment: It would not promise halal certification by opening. The current JAKIM manual requires permanent Muslim staff on every shift and three months of operation before a new application, so it warned not to assume certification in April 2027. It also labelled the 30% delivery commission as an assumption, because no current published rate could be confirmed.

phases.title: Pull the research together and recover the missing ingredient prices
Build the recalculating workbook, the plan page and the sources-and-calculations file
phases.note: Prices, cups per day, rent and ingredient costs can all be changed
phases.judgment: It did not tidy the result into a yes. The own-brand plan dips to RM 27,398 in the slow-start months, below the RM 30,000 reserve target, and the franchise option needs RM 190,000 against a RM 170,000 ceiling, so neither was called ready for a lease.

phases.title: Independently check the arithmetic, recalculate the workbook and view the page on desktop and phone
phases.judgment: The independent colleague matched 131 of its own recomputed results, yet still flagged three weak spots: advance rent above one month was not fully credited (RM 5,300 too low), borrowing could pass the RM 50,000 limit without a warning, and a zero pack size silently made an ingredient free. After the fixes, a second pass ran 290 edit-and-recalculate tests that all passed.

workers: Checked the official rules for registering the business, council licences, food handling and halal certification
Looked for dated kiosk rents and deposits in Kuala Lumpur and Petaling Jaya malls, equipment prices and published franchise packages
Priced tea, milk, pearls, cups and packaging from supplier lists to work out the cost of each drink
Recomputed the workbook’s numbers on its own and tested it by changing price, cups per day, rent and ingredient costs

chipNames.https://www.mof.gov.my/portal/ms/berita/: Ministry of Finance: service tax on rental

zh.askTitle: 把格子换成你自己的档口计划，得到同样的自创品牌与加盟现金流测试
zh.runTitle: 吉隆坡：两姐妹用 12 万令吉积蓄开一个奶茶档口

fields.label: 加盟方案
fields.value: 一个小型加盟（还没选定具体方案）

fields.label: 吉隆坡或八打灵再也场地
fields.value: 吉隆坡或八打灵再也的中档购物中心

fields.label: 存款、最高借款及另留个人储备
fields.value: 两人共有 12 万令吉存款；借款不超过 5 万令吉

fields.label: 全包租金及开业报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：商场全包月租 9,000 令吉的报价，以及 6 万令吉的装修报价

fields.label: 付费销量测试及实收价
fields.placeholder: 例如：两周周末摆摊，每天卖出 80 杯，实收每杯 11.5 令吉

fields.label: 业主工时及所需提款
fields.placeholder: 例如：两人每周各在店里 40 小时，每月各提取 2,000 令吉

fields.label: 清真需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：希望开业当天就取得认证，每个班次都有穆斯林员工

zh.template: 请用{money}、{costs}、{sales}、{owner}和{halal}，比较{site}的自创奶茶档口与{franchise}。列出慢热期现金、盈亏平衡和缺失成本。联系他人、提交表格或分享文件前，请先问我。

phases.title: 调研马来西亚的成本、规定、原料价格和加盟套餐
phases.note: 注册、牌照、工资、清真规定、供应商价格和外卖平台费用
phases.judgment: 它不肯承诺开业时就有清真认证。JAKIM 现行手册要求每个班次都有固定的穆斯林员工，并且要先营业三个月才能提交新申请，所以它提醒不要默认 2027 年 4 月就能拿到认证。外卖平台 30% 的佣金也被标明是假设，因为查不到现行的公开费率。

phases.title: 汇总调研结果，补回缺失的原料价格
制作可重新计算的表格、方案页面和来源与计算文件
phases.note: 售价、日销杯数、租金和原料成本都可以修改
phases.judgment: 它没有把结果粉饰成“可以”。自创品牌方案在慢热期会降到 27,398 令吉，低于 3 万令吉的储备目标；加盟方案需要 19 万令吉，超出 17 万令吉的上限，所以两个方案都没有被说成可以签租约。

phases.title: 独立核对算术、重新计算表格，并在电脑和手机上查看页面
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事重算后有 131 项结果与表格吻合，但仍指出三处隐患：超过一个月的预付租金没有完全计入（少算 5,300 令吉）、借款超过 5 万令吉上限时不会提醒、包装数量填 0 会让原料悄悄变成零成本。修复之后，第二轮做了 290 项修改后重算的测试，全部通过。

workers: 核对官方关于公司注册、市政牌照、食品操作和清真认证的规定
查找吉隆坡和八打灵再也商场档口带日期的租金和押金、设备价格以及公开的加盟套餐
根据供应商价目表给茶叶、牛奶、珍珠、杯子和包装定价，算出每杯饮品的成本
独立重算表格里的数字，并通过改动售价、日销杯数、租金和原料成本来测试
